name: Order Sample Compression of the Chen Neighbor Puncture
proof: Write $\mathcal N=\mathcal N_{\mathrm{CCT}}$, and use $\mathcal C_0,h$ from its definition. Every five-coordinate sample of $h$ is realized by a neighbor $h^{(i)}\in\mathcal N$ at an omitted coordinate. Therefore $\mathcal C_0\subseteq C_5(\mathcal N)$. If $\mathrm{OSC}(\mathcal N)\le4$, survey Corollary cor:order-compression-trace-completion gives $\mathrm{OSC}(C_5(\mathcal N))\le4$. This contradicts $\mathrm{OSC}\ge\mathrm{RTD}$ and $\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal C_0)=5$, using subclass monotonicity. Thus OSC is at least five. For the upper bound, every word lies within Hamming distance eight of $c=\mathtt{110000110000}$. Order the full cube by increasing distance to $c$, breaking ties arbitrarily. The first hypothesis consistent with a sample is $c$ modified only at its sampled disagreement coordinates. Keeping exactly those examples gives an order scheme of size at most eight. Hence $5\le\mathrm{OSC}(\mathcal N)\le8$; no exact value is asserted.
references: Definition-driven certificate and independent replay: sync/verify_chen_neighbor_puncture.py; sync/chen_neighbor_puncture_certificate.json.gz. The original Chen base is from \cite{chen2016recursive}; the puncture modification and its separation proof are local results.
details: A strict finite separation from projected RTD four. The known bounds are 5 <= OSC <= 8; an exact value and an unbounded family are not claimed.
